tech.title: The right tech for your project
tech.subtitle: No imposed list: we pick the tools after understanding your need. Here is how it works.
tech.q1: "I want to sell online, my customers pay with Wave and Orange Money."
tech.a1: A fast online store with built-in mobile money payments and automatic receipts — field-tested.
tech.q2: "My team wastes hours on Excel files that keep breaking."
tech.a2: A custom management app: one central database, per-user roles, real-time dashboards.
tech.q3: "Our connection is unstable, the app must keep working."
tech.a3: Offline-first design: data is saved locally, then synced as soon as the network returns.
tech.q4: "What if my business grows? I don't want to rebuild everything in 2 years."
tech.a4: A scalable architecture from day one: start simple, add modules as you grow.
tech.adapt_title: The stack? It adapts to you.
tech.adapt_desc: Web, mobile, data, cloud, security or AI: the tooling depends on your project, budget and users — never the other way around. Every technology on the market is a tool in the box, not a ready-made answer.
